title: A Fighting Chance
description:
There is more to do with a Soul Light focus than simply lighting the area. Yes, it can indeed be empowered, but I suggest we hold off on that. Rather, I emplore you to gather some ectoplasm and arrows, taking your Soul Light Focus and changing it into a Soul Bolt focus.
While the bolt may at first seem slow and weak, it can become mighty powerful when properly enchanted.
description_completed: And with this Soul Bolt focus, you've learned all the basics I've to teach you. Now, I entrust you with the Black Book. Do make good use of it in your travels. I cannot wait to see what will become of you.
